act.long_title: An Act to define and amend the law relating to certain kinds of specific relief.

section.heading: Alternative prayer for rescission in suit for specific performance
section.html: A plaintiff instituting a suit for the specific performance of a contract in writing may pray in the alternative that, if the contract cannot be specifically enforced, it may be rescinded and delivered up to be cancelled; and the court, if it refuses to enforce the contract specifically, may direct it to be rescinded and delivered up accordingly.
